description: This file declares the NetworkChangeNotifier class and related enums and observer interfaces for monitoring system network changes, including connection type, DNS, bandwidth, and network interfaces. It provides static methods for managing observers, querying network state, and triggering notifications.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages network change notifications, observer registration, and network state queries. Supports various observer interfaces for IP address, connection type, DNS, bandwidth, network list, and default network activity. Provides static methods for creating, configuring, and triggering notifications.

classes.name: NetworkChangeObserver
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about network changes such as connection type, IP address changes, and network availability.

classes.name: MaxBandwidthObserver
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about changes in maximum network bandwidth.

classes.name: ConnectionCostObserver
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about changes in network connection cost.

classes.name: IPAddressObserver
classes.description: Deprecated interface for IP address change notifications.

classes.name: ConnectionTypeObserver
classes.description: Deprecated interface for connection type change notifications.

classes.name: DNSObserver
classes.description: Interface for DNS configuration change notifications.

classes.name: NetworkObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing network connection events on Android.

classes.name: DefaultNetworkActiveObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing when the default network enters a high power state on Android.

methods.name: CreateIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates the process-wide platform-specific NetworkChangeNotifier if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: GetMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum bandwidth and connection type.

methods.name: AddNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for network change events.

methods.name: RemoveNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer for network change events.

methods.name: TriggerNonSystemDnsChange
methods.description: Signals a non-system DNS configuration change.
